_note: Strings a reader still sees in English after i18n.js has run, read off the rendered pages themselves: copy that a script writes into the page, which tools/i18n/extract.py never sees because it is not in the source. `en` is the text the browser holds, so its hash is the one i18n.js looks up; `where` and `pages` say where it was found. Harvested with tools/i18n/harvest.js, which only reports a string whose hash is in no dictionary.

blocks.en: 0.58 Å across the eight peptide-bearing runs
blocks.zh: 八次含胜肽模擬跨幅 0.58 Å
9 個系統 · 每條 30 ns · 25.9 GPU 小時 · 13,500 個影格

blocks.en: Asn23–Arg487, every saved frame of all eight runs
blocks.zh: Asn23–Arg487，八次模擬所有存下的影格

blocks.en: Backbone RMSD against the salt bridge, eight runs
blocks.zh: 主鏈 RMSD 對鹽橋，八次模擬

blocks.en: Closest approach between the Asn23 oxygens and the Arg487 side chain, measured off the coordinates in each report. The dashed line is 3.5 Å. Two runs sit on it and never leave; two come off it repeatedly, and an occupancy alone would not tell you which. Note that a close contact is not the same as a salt bridge: the tagged run is inside 3.5 Å almost always and still scores 2.4% bidentate, because it has one oxygen to offer.
blocks.zh: Asn23 的氧與 Arg487 側鏈之間的最近距離，由各份報告的座標量得。虛線為 3.5 Å。兩條軌跡貼在線上從不離開；兩條反覆脫離，而單看佔有率無法分辨是哪兩條。要注意近距離接觸不等於鹽橋：帶標籤的那次模擬幾乎一直在 3.5 Å 以內，雙齒卻只有 2.4%，因為它只有一個氧可以提供。

blocks.en: Each chip is one run, with what it changed and how it came out. The four limbs are the four things that vary.
blocks.zh: 每一個小塊是一條軌跡，上面寫著它改動了什麼、結果如何。四條分支就是會變動的那四件事。

blocks.en: One cell per residue per run: how much of the 30 ns that residue spent within 4 Å of the receptor. Blank cells are residues the construct does not have. Read down a column to see whether a position survives truncation; read across a row to see where a construct actually holds on. The letters underneath are the BoPep4 wild-type sequence; the AtPep1 row is a different peptide at the same numbering, so hover a cell for its own residue.
blocks.zh: 每個殘基、每條軌跡一格：該殘基在 30 ns 中有多少時間落在受體的 4 Å 以內。空白格是該構築沒有的殘基。往下讀一欄，看某個位置能不能撐過截短；橫著讀一列，看一個構築實際上靠哪裡抓住。下方的字母是 BoPep4 的野生型序列；AtPep1 那一列是另一條胜肽，沿用同一套編號，因此把指標移到格子上會顯示它自己的殘基。
每殘基接觸佔有率，八個構築

blocks.en: Putting Lys7 and Lys8 back onto 9-23 restores the clamp. Not because a free-terminus artefact went away: Lys7 grips Asp129, a salt bridge that is not on Tang's list of eight. This is also the first construct that is like-for-like with the benchmark.
blocks.zh: 把 Lys7 與 Lys8 接回 9-23，夾持就恢復了。原因不是什麼自由末端的假象消失了：Lys7 抓住 Asp129，而這座鹽橋不在 Tang 的八個熱點清單上。這也是第一個能與基準做同規格比較的構築。

blocks.en: Receptor Cα RMSD, with and without a peptide
blocks.zh: 受體 Cα RMSD，有胜肽與無胜肽

blocks.en: Right is a more mobile backbone, up is an intact bidentate salt bridge. If steadiness predicted chemistry the points would fall on a line. They do not, and the two lowest-RMSD points in the set are the tagged construct and the run that failed its gate.
blocks.zh: 往右是主鏈更易動，往上是雙齒鹽橋完整。如果穩定度能預測化學，這些點就會落在一條線上。它們沒有，而整組中 RMSD 最低的兩個點，正是帶標籤的構築與未通過門檻的那一條軌跡。

blocks.en: Six histidines fused after Asn23. All four acceptance criteria pass and the C-terminus scores as steadier than wild type. But Asn23 is no longer a C-terminus: its carboxylate was spent forming the amide bond, so the criterion is measuring a neutral carbonyl rather than a salt bridge.
blocks.zh: 在 Asn23 之後接上六個組胺酸。四項接受標準全部通過，C 端的分數甚至比野生型更穩。但 Asn23 已經不是 C 端：它的羧酸根已用於形成醯胺鍵，所以這項標準量到的是一個中性羰基，而不是一座鹽橋。

blocks.en: The apo run is the leftmost mark. Removing the peptide entirely moves the receptor less than swapping one peptide for another does, which is what puts a floor under every receptor-side comparison on the other eight pages.
blocks.zh: 最左邊的標記是 apo 那條軌跡。把胜肽整個移除，受體移動的幅度比把一條胜肽換成另一條還小，這就替另外八頁上每一項受體端的比較墊下了一條底線。

blocks.en: Two frames, not two drawings. Each is the frame closest to its own run's median Asn23–Arg487 distance, the receptors are superposed, and the same 179 receptor Cα are drawn from the same angle in both panels, so anything that differs here differs in the simulation. Depth is shown by fading.
blocks.zh: 這是兩個影格，不是兩張畫。每一個都是最接近該條軌跡 Asn23–Arg487 中位距離的影格，受體已彼此疊合，兩個面板都以相同角度畫出同樣那 179 個受體 Cα，所以這裡有差別的地方，在模擬裡就有差別。深度以淡化表示。

attrs.en: Map of the nine molecular dynamics runs
attrs.zh: 九條分子動力學軌跡的地圖

attrs.en: Binary docking: protectant into its partner
attrs.zh: 二元對接：保護劑進入它的夥伴

attrs.en: Fraction of native contacts against ligand RMSD for all 68 cluster representatives, with the CAPRI acceptable and medium tier boundaries drawn. Three clusters reach medium, 26 acceptable, none high.
attrs.zh: 全部 68 個分群代表的原生接觸比例對配體 RMSD，並畫出 CAPRI 的 acceptable 與 medium 等級邊界。三個分群達到 medium，26 個達到 acceptable，沒有一個達到 high。

attrs.en: HADDOCK score against fraction of native contacts for all 68 cluster representatives. The relationship is weak, Spearman rho minus 0.21.
attrs.zh: 全部 68 個分群代表的 HADDOCK 分數對原生接觸比例。兩者的關係很弱，Spearman ρ 為負 0.21。

attrs.en: HADDOCK score against interface RMSD for all 68 cluster representatives across the nine runs. The points form a broad cloud rather than a funnel.
attrs.zh: 九次執行中全部 68 個分群代表的 HADDOCK 分數對介面 RMSD。這些點形成一團寬散的雲，而不是漏斗。
與 BAK1 的三元組裝

attrs.en: The PEPR1 receptor C-alpha trace with the peptide threaded along its inner groove. Ten of the seventeen resolved positions are identical between BoPEP4 and AtPep1; seven differ and are marked.
attrs.zh: PEPR1 受體的 Cα 軌跡，胜肽沿著它的內側凹槽穿線。十七個已解出的位置中有十個在 BoPEP4 與 AtPep1 之間完全相同；七個不同，並已標示出來。

attrs.en: The PROPEP PEP4 clade redrawn as a cladogram. BoPEP4 from Brassica oleracea sits beside BrPROPEP4 from Brassica rapa, one residue away; AtPROPEP4 from Arabidopsis thaliana is the characterised member.
attrs.zh: PROPEP 家族的 PEP4 支系重新繪製成親緣分支圖。來自 Brassica oleracea 的 BoPEP4 位在來自 Brassica rapa 的 BrPROPEP4 旁邊，兩者相差一個殘基；來自 Arabidopsis thaliana 的 AtPROPEP4 是已做過性質鑑定的成員。

attrs.en: The molecular progression: a typed sequence is threaded onto the AtPep1 backbone from 5GR8, docks into the PEPR1 groove, gains BAK1 as a co-receptor, and is ranked and validated.
attrs.zh: 分子層面的進程：一條文字序列被穿線到 5GR8 的 AtPep1 骨架上，對接進 PEPR1 的凹槽，加上 BAK1 作為共受體，再經過排名與驗證。
